Question: Using NHANES from 2005 to 2008  we will run a logistic regression  where the predictor is  monocyte count/lymphocyte count*10 and outcome is proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Covariates include age, sex, race categorized as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american, and other. We will include  patients whose age is equal or more  than 40 years old, has diabetes defined as as one of the following (1) Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 6.5%,(2) Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) ≥ 7 mmol/L; (3) during an oral glucose tolerance test, 2-h plasma glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L; (4) self-report questionnaire data indicating physician diagnosis of diabetes; and (5) lower blood glucose by current use of insulin or diabetes pill. Exclude participants with missing data on retinopathy grading, and missing  peripheral blood MLR calculated as monocyte count/lymphocyte count * 10 and without diabetic retinopathy.
Structured Question:
Analysis Type: logistic regression

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 2005-2008

Inclusion Criteria:
- age >= 40 years old
- has diabetes defined as any of the following:
    (1) Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 6.5%
    OR
    (2) Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) ≥ 7 mmol/L
    OR
    (3) during an oral glucose tolerance test, 2-h plasma glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L
    OR
    (4) self-report questionnaire data indicating physician diagnosis of diabetes
    OR
    (5) lower blood glucose by current use of insulin or diabetes pill

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing retinopathy grading
- missing peripheral blood MLR
- without diabetic retinopathy (i.e., diabetic retinopathy = No)

Covariates:
- age
- sex
- race categorized as:
    non-hispanic white
    non-hispanic black
    mexican american
    other

Predictor:
- peripheral blood MLR calculated as:
    monocyte count / lymphocyte count * 10

Outcome:
- proliferative diabetic retinopathy mapped as:
    1 if proliferative diabetic retinopathy = Yes
    0 if proliferative diabetic retinopathy = No

-- STEP 1.2: From the above group, include only those who have diabetes

WHERE (f."glycohemoglobin" >= 6.5
   OR f."fasting_glucose_mmol_l" >= 7
   OR f."two_hour_glucose_ogtt_mmol_l" >= 11.1
   OR f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes'
   OR f."taking_insulin_now" = 'Yes');

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude participants with missing data on retinopathy grading
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."retinopathy_level_worse_eye" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude participants with missing peripheral blood MLR components
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."monocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" != 0; -- Exclude division by zero for MLR calculation

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants without diabetic retinopathy
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" = 'Yes';

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age (Covariate)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age_years"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex (Covariate)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race (Covariate)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican american'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" IN ('Other Hispanic', 'Other Race - Including Multi-Racial') THEN 'other'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "race"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Peripheral Blood MLR (Predictor)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_peripheral_blood_mlr AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       (f."monocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" / f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" * 10.0) AS "peripheral_blood_mlr"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.5 Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy (Outcome)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_proliferative_diabetic_retinopathy AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."retinal_new_vessels_on_disc_worse_eye" IN ('< 10A', 'Questionable') THEN 1
           ELSE 0
       END AS "proliferative_diabetic_retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  age."age_years",
  sex."sex",
  race."race",
  mlr."peripheral_blood_mlr",
  pdr."proliferative_diabetic_retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age age ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = age."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_sex sex ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = sex."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_race race ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = race."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_peripheral_blood_mlr mlr ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = mlr."respondent_sequence_number"
JOIN temp_proliferative_diabetic_retinopathy pdr ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = pdr."respondent_sequence_number";

        is.character(column) | is.factor(column)      ~ "categorical",

        } else {
        summary_info <- NA
        }

        n_unique   = n_unique,

    }

    # Set reference level

    }
